title: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates in String
statement: Repeatedly remove adjacent pairs of the same character until none remain. Return the final string.
hints: A stack stores the characters that have not yet been cancelled.
If the new character equals the top, pop. Otherwise push.
The stack from bottom to top is the answer. Removals cascade because the new top is checked on the next character.

approaches.name: Stack
approaches.explanation: Each character is pushed and popped at most once.

editorial: The stack is the string built so far, with every adjacent duplicate already removed. A new character either cancels the last survivor or becomes a new survivor. That local rule is enough because a cancellation only exposes the previous survivor, which is exactly the stack top.
